neighbours.label: the word that opens a time-span quantity ('in one to two weeks', 'over three days', 'in the first half of'), on the token before the number or unit
fire: The seedlings usually sprout in one to two weeks if the soil stays warm.
Swelling tends to go down over five days once the cast is removed.
The company plans to hire two hundred people in the second half of next year.
The kittens open their eyes in one or two weeks after they are born.
Prices rose sharply over four months as the drought went on.
Most of the snow melted in a few days once the sun came out.
The new store should open in the first quarter of 2027, the owners said.
Bruises like this usually fade in one to three weeks without treatment.
quiet: The seedlings usually sprout in rich soil if it stays warm and damp.
Swelling tends to go down when you raise the leg above the heart.
The company plans to hire two hundred people for the new warehouse.
The kittens open their eyes and start to crawl around the box.
Prices rose sharply over the border as the drought went on.
Most of the snow melted on the roof once the sun came out.
The new store should open on the main square, the owners said.
Bruises like this usually fade without any cream or treatment.
